labels.value: TC-F05: Filter key 'brand' must exist for keyword 'SON MOI'

name: TC_F05_BrandFilterMustExist
description: Business rule: the 'brand' filter is mandatory for lipstick (SON MOI) searches because brand is a primary purchase decision factor for this category. Absence of the brand filter would break the filter panel on the product listing page.
